description: Send Tendmark Buildings a requirement (Organize my building’s Clean Buildings compliance). Your request is recorded with a reference number. Tendmark will review applicability evidence and existing work, establish data access needs, arrange qualified-role and implementation responsibilities, and develop a building-specific scope and indicative fee. We reply by email when you leave an address, carrying forward this brief and its open questions. Nothing is ordered or committed until you agree terms. Contact details are kept apart from the requirement, while we correspond or do business and for 24 months after, so a later request picks up where it left off; ask us to delete them at any time. It is answered with a receipt: keep its id and token to read its status (request_status), to add details later (continuation) and to act on an offer made in reply. A requirement is not an order and costs nothing.

continuation.description: The receipt id and token of an earlier request, to add to it instead of opening a new one
